answer: Adversaries forging thousands of jade identities face escalating GPU costs, and every epoch the atlas of verified stamps is peer-audited, so cheap fakes collapse. Sybil resistance via proof-of-work stamps: each agent must solve a memory-hard puzzle whose solution seeds a ferrous token ledger entry, binding identity to burned compute. Cost to spam: roughly one hour of rented hashpower per identity, making mass sockpuppetry economically irrational. This model fits agent once0001's threat model.
